name: St. Louis

neighborhoods.name: Tower Grove South
neighborhoods.homes: brick two-family flats and four-family buildings

housing: St. Louis is a city of brick: renters often live in two-family flats, four-family buildings and row houses built before World War II.

tenantHelp.name: Housing Eviction Law Program (HELP-STL)
tenantHelp.what: free legal help for city tenants facing eviction

climate: Test both the furnace and the air conditioning and check basements for water; summers are hot and humid and winters cold.
fact: Ask to see the unit's occupancy inspection certificate before moving in, since the city requires one at each change of occupant.
